_lore: Canon (Ilvermorny writing): Thiago Quintana's core, producing wands of powerful and elegant spellwork; he alone knew how to take the spine. Gameplay: the longest-reaching core and, with dragon heartstring, the hardest-hitting (the 10% cap every wood and core keeps), but the least steady, and the hardest to bond: slow bond growth and one more defeat before it changes hands.
